crossRefs.note: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.
However I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and…
“ ‘However I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand; but I will make him prince all the days of his life, for…
Nevertheless for David’s sake, Yahweh his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to…
because David did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all…
‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.’ ”
Afterward the children of Israel shall return, and seek Yahweh their God, and David their king, and shall come with…
Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.
But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
“Yahweh God, don’t turn away the face of your anointed. Remember your loving kindnesses to David your servant.”

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
translations.bsb: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.
translations.kjv: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
translations.asv: For thy servant David's sake Turn not away the face of thine anointed.
